snippet.title: Guns of Eschaton - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Guns of Eschaton is a Soulslike first-person shooter set in an apocalyptic, occult version of nineteenth-century America. It's the final original world designed by the late Viktor Antonov, art director of Half-Life 2 and Dishonored. Special ammo, parries, dashes and a Codex that reveals enemy weaknesses make every shot count. It's coming to PS5, Xbox Series and PC in 2026.
